description: This is a Java test source file containing unit tests for boolean converters in the Apache OFBiz framework. It defines test methods to verify conversions between Boolean and other types like Integer, String, and Collection, utilizing JUnit assertions.

classes.name: TestBooleanConverters
classes.description: A JUnit test class testing various boolean conversion routines in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: assertFromBoolean
methods.description: Asserts that a Boolean converter correctly converts true and false values to specified target types.

methods.name: assertToBoolean
methods.description: Asserts that a source-to-Boolean converter correctly converts true and false source values to Boolean.TRUE and Boolean.FALSE.

methods.name: assertToCollection
methods.description: Verifies that converting a source object results in collections containing the source.

methods.name: testBooleanConverters
methods.description: JUnit test method that loads the boolean converters and runs conversion assertions.
